Theorem
[Local monotonicity formula under Ricci flow] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0396, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0397 1. ch26:26.44\group Ricci Flow Heat Balls

For $I(r)=P(r)/r^n$ and $0<r_1<r_2$, \[ I(r_2)-I(r_1)=-\int _{r_1}^{r_2}\frac n{r^{n+1}} \iint _{E_r}\left[ \frac uv(\partial _t+\Delta -R)v+\psi _r(\partial _t-\Delta )u \right]d\mu _{g(t)}dt\, dr. \]
